name: g2-i1current-vs-i2memory-c3-v1
question: Same RF (C3 settings, class_weight None), same preprocessing rules, same training data: how much does adding bot internal memory (fight/reflex/care allowlist) improve reproduction of the past selected_rule over I1-current? Not a comprehensive I2: res excluded in both.
note_on_C3: C3 is used here as a fixed setting for the input comparison; the pre-registered selected model of the I1-current experiment remains C4

inputs.I1_current: exactly rf_i1current.features + Encoder (imported unchanged from the committed script)
inputs.I2_memory: I1_current columns (identical values) + the memory allowlist below; nothing else
memory_numeric: last time damage was dealt or approach reset (duel.py:654,1629,1640)
closest horizontal distance so far (stuck check); None -> NaN
timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past)
timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past)
timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past)
timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past)
timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past)

timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past)
value if wait_t0 set else NaN
_t as is (>0 = no-backstab window still open); 0.0 -> NaN+missing

timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past); key absent in older versions -> NaN+missing
Moves.swung: last time each foe was seen in an attack anim, any thread (moves.py:252-262)
1 if == tick.ptr, 0 if other/None; key absent -> NaN+missing
1 if not None (pointer value not used)
None = reflex memory has no attack start / last reflex-seen anim not ATTACK (re-checked: 50 train scenes have current tick.a in ATTACK with age None)
bot's own judgement signal (Field.Care.wants), not a raw world observation
memory_categorical: target anim seen by rule_after_swing on the previous evaluation; -1 -> 'idle'; key absent -> '__absent__' (a training category if it occurs in train >=5)
inputs.timer_rule: timer: fight value 0.0 = never set (init) -> NaN + __missing=1; {'_t': r} = wall time stored relative to the tick's now (scenes._plain) -> since = -r seconds (>0 = in the past)
inputs.missing: every memory numeric gets a __missing column (1 when NaN); NaN kept for the forest
inputs.categorical_rule: same as I1: train values >=5 -> column, other train values -> __rare__, unseen -> __unknown__

excluded.fight._foot, _foot_next, _foot_log: --footing option only (12 train scenes), excluded before results
excluded.fight.calm / woke / swung / _foe_y0 raw: pointer-keyed; only target membership / time summaries used
excluded.reflex.anim: previous-anim memory overlaps fight._aprev; not used (decided before results)
excluded.res (all): excluded in both I1 and I2-memory this run
excluded.keys not in this allowlist: not used; no key first seen outside train is added

reproduction.I1: retrain I1-current C3 once in this pipeline and compare scene by scene with the preserved C3 predictions (c34 paired_predictions y_pred_c3); any mismatch is reported, and I1/I2 differences are then not interpreted

metrics: rf_i1current.metrics (acc, macro_f1_baseline_set with baseline A primary_classes, macro_f1_all_true, per-class, confusion, per-run, unweighted run mean); paired both/I1 only/I2 only/both wrong/changed; focus classes after_swing, stagger_punish, reflex, stamina, attack, estus; rare = train support <=5 (block, face, lure) wrong predictions
limits: no memory-update model; not a full decision replay
not a causal effect of any field
test/shift seen several times; not blind
single seed; few eval runs; selected-scene distribution
